assets.name: pixel_environment
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone 2D pixel-art hospital environment background for a dark medical narrative game.
Primary request: a hospital at night, with an empty corridor on the left leading toward a nurses' station, and an empty medical inquiry room on the right containing a worn table, empty chair, stacked closed patient files, and a blank envelope.
Style/medium: carefully hand-placed 2D pixel art with clearly visible square pixels, crisp stair-step edges, economical pixel clusters, limited palette, selective ordered dithering. Like a richly detailed classic 2D adventure game background. No blurry realism, no smooth digital painting, no 3D render, no antialiased soft outlines.
Composition/framing: 16:9 wide landscape panoramic side-view interior. Keep the space easy to read, with a continuous dark floor, strong architectural silhouettes, a darker calm corridor at the left, and the empty inquiry table and chair toward the right. A quiet cinematic environmental background, not a screenshot of a UI.
Lighting/mood: late night, silent institutional unease; cool cyan emergency ambience, one small warm amber practical desk lamp. Pixel-stepped light pools and shadows.
Color palette: dark teal, deep violet-black, muted grey-green, sparing amber highlights.
Constraints: no people, no human silhouettes, no gore, no monster, no readable text anywhere, all papers and signs unmarked, no interface, no typography, no game title, no logos, no watermark, no borders. Generate exactly one image.

assets.name: sheet_A
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original anime character portrait sheet for dialogue cards in a 2D medical narrative game.
Canvas and layout: landscape 3:2 canvas, preferably 1536 x 1024 pixels. Exactly THREE equal-width vertical columns, one adult character centered within each third. All three portraits use exactly the same scale and camera framing: top of head through waist. Keep the full hair, head, shoulders, and both arms entirely inside their own third with generous clear side margins. Keep heads below a consistent top margin. Do not let any character cross the one-third or two-thirds boundaries. No drawn panel borders; separation is empty flat background so each third can be mechanically cropped into a portrait card.
Style/medium: detailed clean ink linework and flat cel-shaded anime color blocks, expressive faces, early-2010s 2D anime narrative game standing portraits. The figures themselves are crisp hand-drawn anime illustration, NOT pixel art. Original designs only, no recognizable existing characters. Serious adult medical drama; modest practical clothing and believable age differences.
Background: one completely uniform flat dark teal #0A3038 over the entire canvas; no texture, scenery, gradient, shadows behind figures, ornamental effects, or graphic panels.
Lighting and color: restrained cool cel shading with subtly warm natural skin, clear readable expressions, muted professional clothing.
Constraints: exactly three characters in the specified left-to-right order. Waist-up portraits only. No text, letters, numbers, names, symbols, logos, badges, readable labels, signatures, watermark, weapons, UI or decorative card frame. Do not crop hair or arms. No sexualized poses or clothing. Generate exactly one sheet image.
Characters, strictly from left to right:
LEFT THIRD: a Chinese male medical director around 50, grey at his temples, neat short black-and-grey hair, thin rectangular glasses, white doctor's coat over a dark navy shirt. Stern distant expression, mature angular face, restrained posture with arms held close to his torso.
MIDDLE THIRD: a Chinese female head nurse around 40, short dark brown hair, neat professional pale grey-blue nurse uniform with a modest closed neckline. Firm resolute expression, mature adult face, upright confident posture, arms resting naturally near her sides.
RIGHT THIRD: a Chinese male resident doctor around 28, slightly messy black hair, white doctor's coat, loosely arranged shirt neckline. Tired readable eyes and subtle under-eye shadows, weary restrained expression, slightly slouched posture.
